breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains the conflicting instruction, stating 'gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid of 8 × 8 × 6 for the vc-relax calculation, with an automatic half-grid shift.' This repeats the original error of combining a gamma-centered grid with a half shift. The ground truth simply specifies a gamma-centered k-point grid without any mention of a half shift.
